Name: Seed Sifter
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
Do you ever get sick of having hundreds of mixed seeds and having nothing to do with them? Do you want an easier way of getting seasonal seeds? If so, you've come to the right place! This mod adds a new big craftable, the Seed Sifter. It is unlocked at level 3 farming, and can do the following:
* Convert 10 mixed seeds to a random seasonal seed pack (takes 20 in game minutes)
* Convert 7 mixed flower seeds to a random seasonal seed pack (takes 30 in game minutes)

Compatible with Automate!

Manifest.Name: (CP) Seed Sifter
Manifest.Description: Adds a seed sifter that creates seasonal seed packs from mixed seeds.
Manifest.Author: Nullnnow
